summary.text: Alfonso Lopez is a Democratic member of the Virginia House of Delegates for District 3, representing part of Arlington County and part of the city of Alexandria, serving since 2012. The House's member profile lists committee assignments including Agriculture, Chesapeake and Natural Resources (chair), Communications, Technology and Innovation, and Labor and Commerce.

paragraphs.text: Alfonso H. Lopez was born in Williamsport, Pennsylvania, according to the House's member profile.
The profile says he earned a B.A. from Vassar College in 1992 and a J.D. from Tulane University Law School in 1995, and lists his occupation as partner in a public and government relations firm.
The profile lists him as Majority Whip from 2020 to 2022 and as founder and co-chairman of the Virginia Environment and Renewable Energy Caucus and the Virginia Latino Caucus.
